content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Add the BT Event Scheduler Component to the Event Record ## slug: ev-ss-add-bt-event-scheduler-component-event-record ## seoTitle: Add the Event Scheduler Component to the Event Record ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Complete the steps below to add Messaging’s Communication tab to your {{variable.Object_Event}} object. 1. Open an {{variable.Object_Event}} record. 2. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}}. 3. Click **Edit Page**. ![AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_1.jpg){height="" width=""} 5. Click the “More” tab in the Event page layout. ![AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_2.png){height="" width=""} 7. Click **Add Tab**. ![AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_3.png){height="" width=""} 9. Click the new tab and select {{variable.Field_SF_TabLabel}} = “Custom”. 10. Enter {{variable.Field_SF_CustomLabel}} = “Communication”. ![AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_4.png){height="" width=""} 2. Click **Done**. 3. Move the Communication tab to the top of the Tabs list so {{variable.Field_SF_FirstTab}} = “Communications”. 4. Set {{variable.Field_SF_DefaultTab}} = “First Tab.” 5. In the left navigation pane under Components, search for “BT Event Scheduler.” 6. Click and drag the BT Event Scheduler component to the Communication tab. ![AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_5.png){height="" width=""} 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 9. Click **Activate**. 10. Click the App Default tab. 1. Click **Assign as App Default**. ![AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_6](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_6.png){height="" width=""} 3. Select “Events (Admin)” and “Events (Planner)”. 4. Click **Next**. 5. On the Assign Form Factor screen, choose your preferred platform, and click **Next**. ![AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_7](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_7.jpg){height="" width=""} 7. If everything looks okay on the Review Assignments screen, click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 9. Return to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record page. ![AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_8](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/AddEventSchedulertoEventRecord_8.png){height="" width=""} To watch a video of the process, click [here](https://share.getcloudapp.com/DOuk0DjJ){target=`_blank`}.
